update.description:
Returns the workspaces of one organisation that the calling user can reach. The organisation is chosen with the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header and everything else is worked out from the identity of the caller.

An Account Admin or an Organization Admin receives every active workspace of the organisation; every other user receives only the workspaces shared with them. The result is therefore per caller: the same URL and header return different lists for different tokens. The `workspaceId` values returned here are the input of the Get Org Dashboards API and of every workspace-scoped API.

actions.x-migration: Re-swaps the example fields for the current renderer.

1.value:
Note:
  • An Account Admin and an Organization Admin receive every active workspace of the organisation. Every other user receives only the workspaces shared with them, directly or by an email address matching their account.
  • An Organization Admin, or any other user, whose primary email address is not verified receives an empty list. This does not apply to the Account Admin.
  • Workspaces created by certain internal services are not listed for any caller, whatever the role.
  • An empty list is a valid answer. It means that nothing is visible to this caller, not that the organisation is empty. Do not use the list as an inventory unless the caller is an Account Admin or an Organization Admin.
  • The call is allowed on a Client Portal or White Label domain, where the list holds only the workspaces enabled for the requesting domain.

Note:
  • The list is ordered with the newest workspace first, by creation time. There is no sort parameter and no paging - the whole list is returned in one response.
  • isDefault belongs to the caller, not to the workspace. At most one entry is true, and none is when the caller has no default workspace or the default is in another organisation. Do not store it as a workspace attribute.
  • workspaceId, orgId and createdTime are JSON strings. Keep them as strings and do not parse the IDs as 32-bit integers.
  • Some builds return additional fields. Ignore unrecognised keys rather than validating against a closed schema.

update.description:
Returns the dashboards of one organisation that the calling user may read, across all of the workspaces the caller can see or across the workspaces named in `workspaceIds`. The result is paged and is ordered with the most recently modified dashboard first.

Visibility follows the permissions of the caller: a dashboard is returned only when the caller administers its workspace, holds a custom role in it, or the dashboard has been shared with them or made public. Account Admins, Organization Admins and workspace admins see every dashboard in their workspaces. The API is not available on a Client Portal or White Label domain.

actions.x-migration: Re-swaps the example fields for the current renderer.

1.value:
Note:
  • The CONFIG parameter is optional. Without it the first 100 dashboards across every workspace the caller can see are returned. As this is a GET request, the value must be stringified and URL encoded before it is sent.
  • When workspaceIds is omitted the server first counts the workspaces the caller can see. More than 100 fails with error 7476 - name the workspaces in workspaceIds to proceed. The same cap applies to the number of IDs you send. The limit is a server setting and can be changed per organisation.
  • workspaceIds is validated, not filtered. An ID that belongs to another organisation, or that does not exist, fails the whole request with error 7387 rather than being skipped.
  • A CONFIG that is not valid JSON, or a workspaceIds that is not a JSON array, fails with error 8534. A key other than the four documented ones fails with error 8542. A key, or a workspaceIds entry, set to null or to an empty or blank string fails with error 8539 - leave the key out instead.
  • CONFIG accepts at most 11,000 characters in all.

Note:
  • Any member of the organisation may call this API. A user who is not a member is also admitted when they belong to the same Zoho organisation as the Account Admin, and the usual visibility rules then apply. Everyone else receives error 7301.
  • An organisation can have org-level dashboard listing switched off. The Account Admin then receives error 7430 and every other caller receives error 7431.
  • When Access Restrictions are active for the organisation, a caller whose email domain is not a trusted domain for sharing receives an empty list, and a caller who is barred from public views no longer receives public dashboards.
  • The API is disabled on a Client Portal or White Label domain and is rejected there with error 7301.

Note:
  • Only dashboards are returned, whatever else the workspace holds. For every other view type use the workspace-level APIs.
  • The list is ordered with the most recently modified dashboard first. There is no sort parameter.
  • hasNextPage is worked out after duplicate entries, and entries a custom role in the workspace does not allow, have been removed from the page. A page can therefore hold fewer than recordsPerPage entries, and on such a page hasNextPage can be false although later pages still hold dashboards. Keep requesting pages while hasNextPage is true, and do not treat a short page as proof that the list has ended.
  • createdBy, lastModifiedBy and sharedBy are filled only when the caller is an active user of the owning organisation; otherwise they are empty strings. A key is left out when no address can be resolved for it.
  • isFavorite belongs to the caller, not to the dashboard. The isLive field returned for other view types is never sent for a dashboard.
  • Some builds return additional fields. Ignore unrecognised keys rather than validating against a closed schema.

update.description:
Returns the views the calling user opened most recently in one organisation, of any view type, newest first. At most 20 items are returned.

The API reads the own history of the caller and keeps the entries whose workspace is visible to them. It applies no view-level check, so an entry can refer to a view the caller can no longer open; treat the `viewId` as a hint and handle a refusal when you open it.

actions.x-migration: Re-swaps the example fields for the current renderer.

1.value:
Note:
  • Each user has an independent list. The request cannot read the recent items of another user.
  • Entries are kept when their workspace is visible to the caller, exactly as the Get Org Workspaces API works it out. This API does not re-check view-level access, so an entry can refer to a view the caller can no longer open.
  • At most 20 entries are returned, newest first. There is no paging, no limit attribute and no type filter.
  • When the caller has no visible workspace in the organisation the list is empty; the existence of the organisation is still checked and an unknown ID fails with error 8084.
  • The call costs 1 API unit, ten times the cost of the other org-level listings.
  • The call is allowed on a Client Portal or White Label domain, where the entries are limited to the workspaces enabled for that domain.

Note:
  • Tables, reports, dashboards and the other view types appear together in one list.
  • viewName and workspaceName are stored in the recent-items record and are not looked up live.
  • summary reads Get recent views, the same text as the workspace-level recent-views listing. The endpoint is told apart by its URL rather than by summary.
  • Some builds return additional fields. Ignore unrecognised keys rather than validating against a closed schema.

update.description:
Returns the current resource allocation and usage statistics for the specified organisation. This includes metrics such as user seats, row limits, API units, scheduled imports, and other plan-governed resources. Useful for monitoring usage against plan limits.

The authenticated user must be an Account Admin or an Organization Admin of the organisation sent in the `ZANALYTICS-ORGID` header.

actions.x-migration: Re-swaps the example fields for the current renderer.

1.value:
Note:
  • This API is restricted to Account Admins and Organization Admins. A Workspace Admin or a regular user receives error code 7301.
  • allocated returns Unlimited when the plan places no cap on the resource. remaining is then also returned as Unlimited.
  • used returns null when usage tracking for the resource is asynchronous or not yet computed, as happens with archivedrows. remaining is then calculated from allocated assuming zero usage.
  • API unit consumption is tracked at sub-unit precision, so the used and remaining values of apiUnits can hold decimal values.

1.value:
Note:
  • This API is restricted to Account Admins and Organization Admins. Any other role receives error code 7301.
  • When the organisation is on a trial, trialStatus returns true and trialEndsOn is included in the response. billingDate can return -1 during the trial.
  • Internal and ultimate plans do not follow the standard billing cycle. For these plans billingDate returns -1 and trialStatus returns false.
  • When a trial has expired, trialStatus returns false and the organisation can be in a restricted state. Use the Get Resource Details API to check the current limits.
  • addOns returns an empty string when no add-ons have been purchased.

update.description:
Resolves a workspace (and optionally a view) by name to return its numeric IDs. This is useful when you know the human-readable names of a workspace and view but need their IDs to call other workspace-scoped or view-scoped APIs.

- When only `workspaceName` is sent, the response holds the workspace ID, the workspace description, and the organisation ID.
- When both `workspaceName` and `viewName` are sent, the response additionally holds the ID, description, and type of the view.

actions.x-migration: Re-swaps the example fields for the current renderer.

1.value:
Note:
  • Workspace names are unique within an organisation and view names are unique within a workspace. The match is exact and case sensitive, so Sales Analytics and sales analytics are treated as different names.
  • The lookup is scoped to the organisation sent in the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header. A workspace of the same name in a different organisation is not found, and the request fails with error code 7104.
  • When viewName is sent and the view does not exist in the workspace, the request fails with error code 7104. Workspace metadata is not returned in failure responses.
  • When viewName is sent, permission is checked against the view. If the view is not accessible to the user, the request fails with error code 7301 even when the user can see the workspace.
  • A workspace-only lookup succeeds only when at least one view in the workspace is shared with the user. If the workspace holds views but none are shared with the user, the request fails with error code 7301.
  • This API is the recommended way to bootstrap name-based integrations. Resolve workspaceId and viewId here and pass them to downstream APIs, instead of hard-coding numeric IDs that can change across environments.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Verify <workspace-id> and that the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header matches the organisation that owns it.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: EMPTY_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is present but empty.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send a JSON object in CONFIG.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: INVALID_JSON_CONFIGURATION - CONFIG is not valid JSON, or the workspace follows the organisation and the request has neither useOrganizationSettings nor a non-empty section.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send valid JSON with at least one attribute to change.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: ORGID_NOT_PRESENT_IN_THE_HEADER - The ZANALYTICS-ORGID header is missing or empty.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Add the ZANALYTICS-ORGID header with your Organization ID.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: ORGID_NOT_EXIST - No organisation exists with the given ID.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Use the orgId returned by the organisation listing API.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: TRUSTED_DOMAINS_WITHOUT_DOMAIN_RESTRICTION - trustedDomains was sent for a section whose domain restriction is off or is being switched off.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send domainRestrictionEnabled: true with the list, or send domainRestrictionEnabled: false with trustedDomains: [] to clear it.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: TRUSTED_DOMAINS_EMPTY - The domain restriction is on, or being switched on, but the section has no trusted domains.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send at least one domain in trustedDomains, or switch the restriction off.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: DOMAIN_RESTRICTION_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_DISABLED - Domain attributes were sent for privateLinks, publicViews or emailViews while that feature is disabled or is being disabled.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Enable the feature in the same request, or remove the domain attributes.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: EMAIL_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_EXPORT_DISABLED - emailViews was sent while export is disabled or is being disabled, and email views would stay enabled.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Enable export in the same request, or send emailViews: {"enabled": false} when disabling export.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: ORG_ACCESS_RESTRICTION_NOT_ENABLED - The organisation's accessRestrictionEnabled is false.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Enable access restrictions for the organisation with Update Org Access Restrictions, then retry.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: SECTIONS_NOT_ALLOWED_WHEN_APPLYING_ORG_SETTINGS - useOrganizationSettings: true was sent together with a non-empty section.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send useOrganizationSettings: true on its own.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: WORKSPACE_SETTINGS_NOT_ENABLED - The workspace follows the organisation, and the request would update it without useOrganizationSettings: false.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Send useOrganizationSettings: false in the same request to give the workspace its own settings.

x-zenesis-statuscodes.description: INVALID_OAUTHTOKEN - Invalid or expired OAuth token.
x-zenesis-statuscodes.resolution: Provide a valid token with scope ZohoAnalytics.metadata.update.

update.description: Switches one workspace between following the organisation and having its own settings, and updates the workspace's own sections. Returns no body. Read the current state first with Get Workspace Access Restrictions, and read Organisation and Workspace Settings Lifecycle before the first override.
